integrity: The theorem is proved analytically with exact finite checks as corroboration; historical priority is provisional because the complete Mémoli–Needham manuscript was inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Finite metric stars with at least three strictly positive arms and normalized arclength sampling only; does not characterize arbitrary metric trees, nonuniform sampling, or noisy finite-sample stability.
title: Exact metric-star reconstruction from unlabeled pair distances, including invisible curvature knots
